brief: facet turns React templates into datasheets, reports and diagrams: one template, many formats (HTML, PDF, PNG, DOCX, PPTX). The mark should feel precise, print-crafted and quiet, and sit beside UIR and clicky as one Flanksource family.
criteria: Reads as an f at 16 px, says print without a document-icon cliché, works in one colour, belongs with UIR and clicky.

concepts.name: Folded f
concepts.idea: The f's hook is a page corner folded down: print, made from the letter itself.
rationale: Folding a strip on a 45° crease turns its end downward, which is exactly an f's hook
The fold is the one blue accent; the letter stays navy
Built on a 36-unit stroke with a 6-unit seam; a 16-unit seam for the small cut

recommendation: Folded f: chosen direction, delivered with symbol, small cut, horizontal and stacked lockups, one-colour versions and the web icon set.
next_steps: Replace the README and docs header with the horizontal lockup
Ship favicon.svg, favicon.ico and the webmanifest with the docs site
Professional trademark search before external use
